[[Category:Senate Motion]][[Category:386YE Summer]]
__NOTOC__
<quote by="Announced by Groza, Legion Engineer">To fortify Gildenheim in Skarsind with a rank one fortification and the runic wards offered by the Tamazi.</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs a [[fortification]] in Gildermark, [[Skarsind]] as per the '''[[Standing_in_the_sun#Warded_Walls|Standing in the sun]]''' wind of fortune
* Announcement by the [[Legion Engineer]]
* This motion benefited from the [[386YE_Spring_Equinox_Synod_judgements#Judgement_5|mandate]] enacted by '''Viviane Barossa de Coeurdefer'''
==Date==
* Summer 386YE
==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 48 white granite
* 16 mithril
* 240 crowns (paid in full by the [[Tamazi]])
* One year to complete
==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Fortify_Gildenheim}}
==Outcome==
* Once complete, Gildenheim will be protected with a rank one fortification of 3000 strength that takes only half the normal damage from magical attacks such as [[Thunderous Tread of the Trees]].
